name: request
description: HTTP method to send: GET, HEAD, PUT, POST, PATCH, DELETE or OPTIONS. Mirrors curl's -X / --request.

name: header
description: Add a request header; repeat the flag for several. A header set here overrides the desktop's own (e.g. Authorization). Mirrors curl's -H / --header.

name: data
description: Send this string as the request body. Implies POST unless --request is given. Mirrors curl's -d / --data.

name: url
description: The request URI, given as the first non-option argument. An absolute https URL, or a path like /abc/ that is combined with the default scheme, host and port.
